events.content:
The Cobalt Finch Holdings, Inc.’s conditions use differentiated bring-down standards. A specified condition separately addresses certain representations, applying materiality qualifications and special de minimis rules to particular capitalization representations. The remaining representations are tested without their embedded materiality qualifiers, but failures are excused unless they have had or would reasonably be expected to have a Target Material Adverse Effect, individually or in aggregate. Date-specific representations are tested as of their specified dates.

Aster Loom Systems, Inc. must perform its pre-closing covenants in all material respects, and no Target Material Adverse Effect arising since signing may be continuing. An executive-officer certificate dated as of closing must confirm satisfaction of the representation, covenant, and adverse-effect conditions; the certificate is a delivery requirement supporting those underlying conditions. A separate tax certification concerning real-property interests is also required.

- **Key employee:** Mira Solenne must remain employed at closing and must not have given notice of an intention to terminate employment afterward.
- **Stockholder agreements:** The defined Target Stockholder Agreements must have been terminated in full by closing.
- **Certificate:** The executive-officer certificate described above is a separate delivery requirement.

Cobalt Finch Holdings, Inc. and its merger subsidiaries may waive their conditions in writing to the extent legally permitted.

7.4 Frustration of Closing Conditions . None of Parent, Merger Sub or the Company may rely, either as a basis for not consummating the Merger or terminating this Agreement and abandoning the Merger, on the failure of a condition set forth in this Article VII to be satisfied if such failure was caused by such Party’s failure to act in good faith or to use the requisite efforts to cause the Closing to occur as required by this Agreement.

ARTICLE VIII

TERMINATION

8.1 Termination . This Agreement may be terminated at any time prior to the Effective Time, whether before or after the receipt of the Requisite Stockholder Approval (except as otherwise provided in this Agreement), only as follows (it being understood and agreed that this Agreement may not be terminated for any other reason or on any other basis):

(a) by mutual written agreement of Parent and the Company;

(b) by either Parent or the Company if any Restraint has become final and non-appealable, except that the right to terminate this Agreement pursuant to this Section 8.1(b) will not be available to any Party that has failed to comply with the terms of Section 6.1, Section 6.2, Section 6.3 or Section 6.18, as applicable, or to use its reasonable best efforts to resist, appeal, obtain consent pursuant to, resolve or lift, as applicable, such Restraint;

(c) by either Parent or the Company if the Effective Time has not occurred by 11:59 p.m. Eastern time on 2025-12-01 (such time and date, as it may be extended pursuant to Section 9.10(b)(iii), the “ Termination Date ”), provided that (i) if as of the Termination Date (A) the condition set forth in Section 7.1(b) has not been satisfied, (B) the condition set forth in Section 7.1(c) has not been satisfied as a result of a Restraint related to foreign investment review, merger-control or antitrust laws, or (C) the condition set forth in Section 7.1(d) has not been satisfied, then, in each case, the Termination Date shall automatically be extended (without any action required by any Party) to 11:59 p.m.

(a) Manner of Termination . The Party terminating this Agreement pursuant to Section 8.1 (other than pursuant to Section 8.1(a)) must deliver prompt written notice thereof to the other Parties setting forth in reasonable detail the provision of Section 8.1 pursuant to which this Agreement is being terminated and the facts and circumstances forming the basis for such termination.

events.content:
Either party could terminate if the effective time had not occurred by 11:59 p.m. Eastern time on 2025-12-01. The agreement automatically extends that date to 11:59 p.m. Eastern time on 2026-03-01 when specified antitrust, regulatory-restraint, or foreign-investment-review conditions remain unsatisfied. It also extends the deadline by one calendar day per qualifying government-shutdown day, capped at 60 calendar days in aggregate. The outside-date right is restricted, including where the terminating party’s breach primarily caused the failure and while the other party pursues the specified enforcement proceeding.

For a material Larkspur Signal Systems, Inc. breach causing the relevant representation or covenant condition to fail, Cinder Peak Holdings, Inc. generally must allow 40 days after written breach notice, shortened to the time remaining before the termination date, if the breach is curable. Cinder Peak Holdings, Inc. cannot use that right while it or Cinder Peak Merger Sub, Inc. is in material breach. Larkspur Signal Systems, Inc. has a corresponding remedy for qualifying Cinder Peak Holdings, Inc. breaches.

Except for mutual written termination, the terminating party must give prompt written notice identifying the contractual provision and underlying facts in reasonable detail.
